parameters.name: state
parameters.description: whether issue is open or closed

parameters.name: labels
parameters.description: comma separated list of label names. Fetch only issues that have any of this label names. Non existent labels are discarded.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: filter by type (issues / pulls) if set

parameters.name: milestones
parameters.description: comma separated list of milestone names or ids. It uses names and fall back to ids. Fetch only issues that have any of this milestones. Non existent milestones are discarded

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only show items updated after the given time. This is a timestamp in RFC 3339 format

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only show items updated before the given time. This is a timestamp in RFC 3339 format

parameters.name: created_by
parameters.description: Only show items which were created by the given user

parameters.name: assigned_by
parameters.description: Only show items for which the given user is assigned

parameters.name: mentioned_by
parameters.description: Only show items in which the given user was mentioned

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: page number of results to return (1-based)

Token.name: token
Token.description: This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.

AccessToken.name: access_token
AccessToken.description: This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.

AuthorizationHeaderToken.name: Authorization
AuthorizationHeaderToken.description: API tokens must be prepended with "token" followed by a space.

SudoParam.name: sudo
SudoParam.description: Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.

SudoHeader.name: Sudo
SudoHeader.description: Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.

TOTPHeader.name: X-GITEA-OTP
TOTPHeader.description: Must be used in combination with BasicAuth if two-factor authentication is enabled.
